description: Passive record capture from a real FlexiDim Scene Controller on an authenticated site-type-0 local session. Nothing was sent after the authentication record. Counts and record types only; no site address, channel level or key appears here.
conclusion: On an authenticated type-0 local session the controller emits ONLY the f2 channel-level scan, unsolicited. No period, pending-scene, f4 or f5 record appears without a request frame. This matches the recovered binary: the period-flag request is emitted only for encrypted remote sessions.
